text_koine: ἡ Κοάλα καὶ ὁ Δεινόσαυρος παίζουσιν σφαίρᾳ ἔξω παρὰ τὴν οἰκίαν.
text_english: Koala and Dinosaur play outside the house with a ball.
objects: A low wooden fence made of three pale-brown rails and short posts, with smooth rounded tops.
positioning: Koala stands at the left side of the front garden near the low fence, facing right with paws lifted in play.
Dinosaur stands at the right side of the garden near the cobblestone path, facing left with a cheerful stance.
A low wooden fence made of three pale-brown rails and short posts, with smooth rounded tops runs along the back of the garden behind Koala and Dinosaur, with a corner post near Koala.

text_koine: ἰδού! ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ ὁ Κόραξ ἐστίν! μάλα κακός ἐστιν.
text_english: Behold! The Korax is in the sky! Korax is very bad.

text_koine: ὁ Κόραξ τὴν σφαῖραν θέλει καὶ ἔρχεται.
text_english: Korax wants the ball and comes closer.
objects: A bright red ball with a thin white seam.
positioning: Korax is on the right in the air flying downwards
Koala and Dinosaur are on the left playing with the ball and do not see Korax

text_koine: οἴμοι! ὁ Κόραξ κλέπτει τὴν σφαῖραν καὶ φεύγει.
text_english: Oh no! Korax steals Dinosaur's ball and flees.
objects: A bright red ball with a thin white seam.
positioning: Korax is at center-right snatching and turning away with quick motion.
Dinosaur stands at the right reaching forward in surprise as his hands empty.
A bright red ball with a thin white seam is pinched under Korax’s beak and lifted from Dinosaur’s hands.

text_koine: ἡ Κοάλα καὶ ὁ Δεινόσαυρος ὀργίζονται καὶ διώκουσι τὸν Κόρακα.
text_english: Koala and Dinosaur get angry and chase Korax.
objects: A bright red ball with a thin white seam
positioning: Koala and Dinosaur run from left toward right along the garden path with arms outstretched.
Korax flees ahead of them toward the right edge, low over the path with wings tucked and ball in his beak.

text_koine: ἰδού ἡ Γλαῦξ ἀναγινώσκει βιβλίον ὑπὸ τὸ δένδρον.
text_english: Behold Owl reads a book under the tree.
objects: A blue-covered book with a plain cover.
positioning: Owl is sitting peacefully under the tree.

text_koine: ὁ Κόραξ θέλει τὸ βιβλίον καὶ ἔρχεται.
text_english: Korax wants the book and comes.
objects: A blue-covered book with a plain cover.
A bright red ball with a thin white seam.
positioning: Korax approaches low from the right along the path toward the tree, head tilted at the book with the ball in his beak.
Owl remains at the base of the tree on the left, holding steady and looking up.

text_koine: ὁ Κόραξ κλέπτει τὸ βιβλίον καὶ φεύγει.
text_english: Korax steals the book and flees.
objects: A blue-covered book with a plain cover.
A bright red ball with a thin white seam
positioning: Korax holds the ball in his beak and the book in his talons.
Owl leans forward from the tree base reaching out after him.

text_koine: ἡ Γλαῦξ ὀργίζεται καὶ διώκει τὸν Κόρακα.
text_english: Owl gets angry and chases Korax
objects: A bright red ball with a thin white seam
A blue-covered book with a plain cover.
positioning: Owl runs from left toward right along the garden path with wings outstretched.
Korax flees ahead of him fliying toward the right edge, low over the path with wings tucked and ball in his beak and book in his talons.

text_koine: ὁ Δεινόσαυρος διώκει τὸν Κόρακα πρὸ τῆς σχολῆς.
text_english: Dinosaur chases Korax in front of the school.
objects: A bright red ball with a thin white seam
A blue-covered book with a plain cover
positioning: Dinosaur runs from left to right in front of the school building
Korax flies low from left to right with ball in beak and book in talons
Teacher stands in doorway with surprised expression, papers scattered

text_koine: ἡ Κοάλα διώκει τὸν Κόρακα διὰ τῆς ἀγορᾶς.
text_english: Koala chases Korax through the agora.
objects: A bright red ball with a thin white seam
A blue-covered book with a plain cover
market stalls
pottery
positioning: Koala runs from left through market stalls
Korax flies low weaving between stalls
Shopkeeper drops pottery in surprise, mouth open wide

text_koine: ἡ Κοάλα καὶ ὁ Δεινόσαυρος καὶ ἡ Γλαῦξ διώκουσι τὸν Κόρακα διὰ τοῦ ἀγροῦ.
text_english: Koala and Dinosaur and Owl chase Korax through the farm.
objects: A bright red ball with a thin white seam
A blue-covered book with a plain cover
farming tools
vegetables
positioning: All three friends run in a line from left to right through farm fields
Korax flies desperately ahead, looking tired
Farmer drops his hoe and stares in amazement, chickens scatter

text_koine: ἰδού! ὁ Κόραξ τύπτει εἰς τὸ δένδρον!
text_english: Look! Korax strikes into the tree.
objects: A bright red ball with a thin white seam.
A blue-covered book with a plain cover.
positioning: The trunk tree fills the whole picture, with Korax crashing into the tree in an exagerated cartoon fashion for comedic effect. His beak is stuck in the tree like an arrow and he can't get out.
The ball is spat out of Korax's broken beak
The book falls from Korax's talons

text_koine: ἡ Γλαῦξ λαμβάνει τὸ βιβλίον καὶ ἀπέρχεται.
objects: A blue-covered book with a plain cover.
A bright red ball with a thin white seam.
positioning: Owl stands at the base of the tree calmly bending to pick up the book.
Korax is stuck in the tree, his beak firmly wedged into the bark; he is trying to get free.

text_koine: ἡ Κοάλα καὶ ὁ Δεινόσαυρος λαμβάνουσιν τὴν σφαῖραν καὶ ἀπέρχονται.
text_english: Koala and Dinosaur take the ball and go away.
objects: A bright red ball with a thin white seam.
positioning: Korax is stuck in the tree, his beak firmly wedged into the bark; he is trying to get free.
Koala and Dinosaur are below calmly picking up the ball and leaving.
Korax is stuck with his beak in the tree; he has been struggling to get out for a long time, but is tired and exhausted. His body hangs limply with beak comedically stuck in the tree.
